problem_summary: 8 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Kaveripura between January 2019 and May 2022, spanning 4 calendar year(s). 38% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 7 pothole complaints.
5 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹2.1 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (exact_name join).

agency_attribution_note: 8 of 8 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.42). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.38, complaint_volume=0.27.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Kaveripura' matched to datameet243=149 via exact_name (overlap_confidence=0.848).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Kaveripura for the period 2019–2022.
Request inspection records for the 5 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
